We deploy across retail and 3PL logistics, paving a way for integrators to create a revolution in physical AI automation. Lute-0 matches state-of-the-art models thanks to a novel attention mechanism, delivering an order-of-magnitude improvement in data and training efficiency. Nine months in, we are live at Europe’s largest automotive parts distributor. Our models run in hospital corridors, and we work with some of the world’s largest retailers.
